headline: LaunchDarkly: 3 prices, 4 limits, 4 plan names changed (removed “10M Logs and Traces”; added “A/B Tests and Experiments Includes 100K exper…”)
added: Unlimited seats No per-seat pricing. Invite your whole team; pricing is based on usage.
A/B Tests and Experiments Includes 100K experimentation MAU per month at no additional charge.
10M logs and 10M traces /mo A log is a single log line and a trace is a single span, each ingested, stored, and searchable for one month.
5 service connections and 1K client-side MAU /mo A service connection is one server-side SDK connected to one environment for a month. Each unique client-side user or device is one MAU.
5K session replays and 5K errors /mo A session replay is one recorded user session (a single tab instance); an error is one unique error or exception. Each is stored for one month.
5k AI Runs included / mo. An AI run is generated when you track an LLM request or run an online eval (LLM-as-a-judge).
Everything in Developer, plus: Unlimited projects and environments
5 service connections included, pay as you go beyond Your first 5 service connections each month are included. Additional connections bill at $10 each per month.
Scalable observability usage 5K session replays, 5K errors, 10M logs, and 10M traces included each month. Usage beyond that bills as you go.
